item.question: Why is microbial growth rate important in determining successful infections?
item.answer: Microbial growth rate is important because it affects whether an initial microbe can reproduce sufficiently to establish an infection. Higher growth rates increase the likelihood of surpassing the threshold needed for successful infections.
